generator_cmd: gcc -O2 -fPIE -pie -fstack-protector-strong -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -Wl,-z,relro,-z,now -o hard_full t.c  (t.c: strcpy into char buf[64] + printf; gcc 13 Ubuntu)
